name: real-machine-verifier
description: Autonomous real-world program verification engine that runs, monitors, and stress-tests applications on the real Windows machine after virtual simulation. Captures actual process memory, CPU, exit codes, open TCP ports, and native Windows Event Viewer crash records to eliminate speculative guessing.
author: Antigravity Engineering
